description: Hidden text and homoglyph scanner — Scan a string for invisible and deceptive Unicode before it reaches an LLM, a parser or a human approver: Unicode TAG characters (ASCII smuggling prompt injection, decoded into hiddenMessage), bidi overrides (Trojan Source), zero-width characters, variation-selector runs, control and private-use characters, and mixed-script look-alike words (Latin mixed with Cyrillic/Greek). Returns DANGEROUS/SUSPICIOUS/CLEAN, a 0-100 score, positions, the cleaned text and a normalized skeleton for keyword matching. Offline. Param: text (up to 100k chars). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
